component.name: Deductum
component.summary: Isabelle and Lean proofs as literate documents, worked on with agents

description.p: Deductum opens a folder of Isabelle theories or a Lean package as a literate document and a source editor, checked continuously by one shared prover that coding agents use too, on this computer or another.

ul.li: A literate view set like a typeset document (Isabelle's text blocks, Lean's doc comments), and a source view
Goals at any position; Sledgehammer and Find Theorems for Isabelle, exact?-style suggestions and Loogle search for Lean
Sessions that keep running when the window closes, with Pause, Stop and Resume
Agents edit only where you grant rights; your undo is your own, and their changes are reverted one by one
